world_seed: ONE HOST — INFINITE FACES — NO FACE OWNS THE WHOLE

why_24ms.goal: Create a tiny independent scheduling window for provenance stamping, proposal deduplication and conflict discovery without intentionally adding a user-visible conversational pause.
why_24ms.stagger_6ms: Separates face wake-up order enough to avoid a single lockstep instant while keeping all starts inside one micro-window.
why_24ms.gather_12ms: Provides one bounded convergence interval for already-selected active faces to expose compatible or conflicting proposals.
why_24ms.commit_guard_6ms: Reserves a final host-level barrier for provenance checks, HOLD classification and zero-or-one outward commit.
why_24ms.hard_cap_32ms: Provides an 8 ms reference margin for event-loop jitter/bookkeeping; exceeding it does not authorize silent deletion or retroactive world mutation.

allowed_benefits_to_test: give provenance hooks a bounded ordering window
allow duplicate proposal collapse before commit
surface mutually exclusive proposals before one-host arbitration
keep response latency independent of total archived face count

next_gate.name: JANUS_INFINITE_FACES_ASYNC_MICROSTAGGER_FROZEN_LATENCY_AND_CONFLICT_HOLDOUT
targets: measure p50/p95/p99 added wall-clock latency on Linux and Windows event loops
verify no serial accumulation as active workset increases from 1 to 8
inject conflicting proposals at 23.9 ms, 24.1 ms and 32.1 ms boundaries
verify no timing field changes face authority or arbitration weight
compare 0 ms, 8 ms, 16 ms, 24 ms and 32 ms candidate budgets before freezing a production value
